steps.title: Read the original payment
steps.prompt: Read both of these fields of this SEPA dispute (every one is needed): "Original payment · Received" and "Original payment · Payer": when the money reached our customer, and who sent it.

steps.title: Read the recall
steps.prompt: Read all 4 of these fields of this SEPA dispute (every one is needed): "Recall · Reason", "Recall · Asking bank", "Recall · Amount" and "Recall · Deadline": the reason code, the bank asking, the amount and the deadline to answer.

steps.title: Fraud or a mistake?
steps.prompt: Fraud when "Recall · Reason" starts with "FRAD". Customer must agree otherwise (DUPL, TECH, AC03, AM09): the money is our customer's until they say yes.

steps.title: Escalate to fraud
steps.prompt: Run "Escalate to fraud": the money mule alert goes to the fraud team (monitoring may have raised it already) and what is left of the money is held until we answer.

steps.title: Read the customer's consent
steps.prompt: Read both of these fields of this SEPA dispute (every one is needed): "Customer · Consent" and "Customer · Account holder": who holds the account, and whether they were asked, agreed or refused.

steps.title: Customer's answer?
steps.prompt: Not asked when "Customer · Consent" starts with "⚠ Not asked yet". Agreed when it starts with "✓ Agreed". Refused when it starts with "✗".

steps.title: Ask the customer for consent
steps.prompt: Run "Ask the customer for consent": a request goes to the customer in the app and the recall leaves "Recalls we received" until they answer. Nothing is held: the money is theirs until they agree. The result card shows the request, when it was sent and when the answer is due.

steps.title: Is the money still there?
steps.prompt: Read both of these fields of this SEPA dispute (every one is needed): "Funds · On the account" and "Funds · Holds": what can still go back (held for this recall, on a fraud or once the customer agreed, or free on the account), and the holds.

steps.title: Money to send back?
steps.prompt: Money to send back when "Funds · On the account" starts with "✓ All there" or "⚠ Part left". Nothing left when it starts with "✗ Spent".

steps.title: Accept and return the funds
steps.prompt: Run "Accept and return funds": the money goes back to the other bank through STET (a pacs.004 return) and the hold is released. The result card shows what went back, and the interbank message.

steps.title: Refuse with a reason
steps.prompt: Run "Refuse with a reason": the SEPA refusal code is pre-filled (AM04 when no money is left, CUST when the customer refuses); the other bank gets a negative answer through STET. The result card shows the refusal, and the interbank message.
